title_zh: 约定自习期间用耳机并留到四点讨论

scenario.label_zh: 约定共享自习时的安静安排
scenario.goal_zh: 说明分心来源并约定耳机与讨论时间

context_zh: 两位同学共享自习桌，协调各自学习任务与讨论时间。
author: author-phase07-b

sentences.speaker: Yuki
sentences.text: I'm eager to hear what you thought of my presentation, but you look busy.

sentences.speaker: Dan
sentences.text: I am. I have one section left to read, and I keep losing my place.

sentences.speaker: Yuki
sentences.text: Would it distract you if I practised the opening quietly?

sentences.speaker: Dan
sentences.text: A little, yes. Could you listen to your recording through headphones instead?

sentences.speaker: Yuki
sentences.text: Of course. I don't want to disturb anyone else here either.

sentences.speaker: Dan
sentences.text: Thanks. If you can wait until four, I'll listen to you practise outside.

sentences.speaker: Yuki
sentences.text: Four works. I'll review the recording now and save my questions until then.
